title: HR Administrator
description:
Job Title

HR Administrator

Salary

Our salaries are competitive and reviewed regularly to ensure they remain fair and in line with the wider industry.

Location

Tipton

Our Company

Doocey Group is a long-established, family-run utility and civil engineering contractor with over 40 years of industry experience. Built on strong Black Country values, we pride ourselves on integrity, reliability, responsiveness and a commitment to delivering high standards in everything we do.

Over the past 10 years, Doocey Group has experienced significant growth, achieved through consistently deliver high-quality work for our clients, including National Grid and South Staffordshire Water. Our success is built to deliver safely and reliably in a fast-paced and often challenging environment.

As we approach a turnover of 100m, this marks an important milestone in our journey and reflects the hard work, ambition and dedication of our teams across the business. If you are looking to join a growing organisation that values hard work, loyalty and ambition, you will feel right at home at Doocey Group.

The Role

The position of HR Administrator at Doocey Group offers an excellent opportunity to gain further experience in the HR field. The successful candidate will be essential in supporting both the HR Officer and the wider business throughout the employee life cycle in an efficient and performance-oriented manner. You will serve as the liaison between Payroll, HR, Supervisors, Managers, and employees, ensuring smooth communication and prompt resolution of requests and questions. In addition, providing critical administrative support across all aspects of our people processes and services.

Responsibilities
- Act as the first point of contact for HR and payroll queries, ensuring resolution within HR SLAs.
- Support reception with overflow calls and provide reception cover when required.
- Manage HR inboxes and maintain effective communication across the business.
- Keep HR trackers, employee records and HR systems accurate and up to date.
- Support the onboarding, induction and offboarding of employees.
- Prepare employment contracts, offer letters and contractual amendments.
- Coordinate IT access, system setup and ID badge creation for new starters.
- Manage Driver Check records, including licence verification and compliance monitoring.
- Liaise with managers and departments regarding starters, leavers, absences and pay changes.
- Schedule interviews and support recruitment activities.
- Communicate onboarding requirements and conduct Right to Work checks.
- Coordinate training activities and maintain training records.
- Attend HR meetings, take minutes and distribute actions as required.
- Support careers fairs, recruitment events and work experience placements.
- Assist with employee engagement initiatives and company events.
- Provide administrative support, including reporting, filing and correspondence.
- Support the continuous improvement of HR processes and services.
- Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures and relevant legislation.
- Provide cover for HR colleagues and contribute to team objectives.

Technical Skills & Experience
- Personable, approachable and professional manner.
- Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships at all levels.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
- Strong organisational, time management and prioritisation skills.
- Proactive, self-motivated and adaptable approach to work.
- High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
- Ability to work to deadlines and perform effectively under pressure.
- Previous administration experience desirable but not essential.

Qualifications & Training
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
- GCSE Grade 4 (C) or above, or equivalent qualifications.

Additional Information

Doocey Group value a diverse workforce and welcome applications form all sections of the community, regardless of any protected characteristics.

Please note that we operate with a preferred supplier list and will not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies with whom we do not have an existing agreement.

By submitting your application, you consent to Doocey Group retaining your CV, application details, and personal information for the purpose of considering you for current and future employment opportunities. Your information will be stored securely and will only be shared internally as necessary.

title: HR Assistant
description:
As an HR Assistant in West Bromwich, you will manage day-to-day HR administration across the employee lifecycle within the Industrial / Manufacturing sector. You will keep records accurate, organise key processes and help the Human Resources department run smoothly.

Client Details

The organisation operates in the Industrial / Manufacturing sector in West Bromwich.

Description
- Provide HR support and guidance to managers and team leaders on a range of employee relations matters.
- Coordinate and support disciplinary, grievance, and performance management processes, ensuring compliance with company policies and employment legislation.
- Act as a key liaison with external HR and employment law providers, including Peninsula, seeking advice and ensuring recommendations are implemented effectively.
- Manage the onboarding process for new employees, ensuring a smooth and positive start to the business.
- Coordinate employee engagement activities, including employee satisfaction surveys and feedback initiatives.
- Support internal communications by creating and distributing HR updates, newsletters, and people-related communications.
- Review, update, and maintain HR policies, procedures, and employee handbooks to ensure they remain accurate, compliant, and aligned with business needs.
- Maintain employee records and HR systems, ensuring data accuracy and confidentiality.
- Assist with HR projects and continuous improvement initiatives across the People function.

Profile

A successful 'HR Assistant' should have:
- Previous experience in an HR Assistant, HR Administrator or HR Coordinator role.
- Strong knowledge of HR administration and employee lifecycle processes.
- Good knowledge of core HR processes.
- The ability to manage HR records and documentation with care and accuracy.
- Excellent organisational skills.
- Confidence handling routine HR administration in a structured and timely way

Job Offer
- Permanent HR Assistant position in West Bromwich.
- Salary of 30,000
- 20 days' holiday plus Bank Holidays.
- Pension.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

People are at the heart of Michael Page. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment. As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.

title: Early Support Officer - Adult Social Care
description:
Early Support Officer - Adult Social Care

Location: Civic Centre, Wolverhampton
Pay Rate: 15.56 per hour
Contract: temporary
Start Date: As soon as possible
Positions Available: 3

Make a Difference Through Early Intervention

City of Wolverhampton Council is seeking three proactive and compassionate Early Support Officers to join the Adult Social Care Early Support Service.

This rewarding role focuses on helping adults and carers access the right support at the right time, preventing, reducing or delaying the need for long-term care and support services. Working within a strengths-based approach, you will empower people to maximise their independence, build confidence and remain active members of their communities.

This is an excellent opportunity for individuals with experience in health, social care, community support or related services who are passionate about improving outcomes for local residents.

About the Role

As an Early Support Officer, you will work directly with adults and carers, providing timely, personalised and outcome-focused support. You will help people identify their strengths, understand their options and access services, community resources and networks that enable them to live independently.

You will work closely with colleagues across Adult Social Care, health services, voluntary organisations, community groups and families to ensure people receive the support they need to achieve their goals.

Key responsibilities include:
- Supporting adults and carers to maintain independence, choice and control
- Providing strengths-based advice, guidance and practical support
- Helping prevent or delay escalating care and support needs
- Connecting people to community resources, services and support networks
- Supporting individuals through challenging situations with responsive short-term interventions
- Working collaboratively with partner agencies and multidisciplinary teams
- Managing a varied caseload and maintaining accurate records
- Supporting crisis responses and safeguarding processes when required
- Promoting social inclusion, equality and positive outcomes for individuals and carers
- Contributing to service development and continuous improvement initiatives

What We're Looking For

To be successful in this role, you will have:
- Experience working within health, social care, community support or a related field
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills
- Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage a varied workload
- A person-centred and strengths-based approach to supporting people
- The ability to work independently and as part of a wider team
- Confidence building relationships with a range of professionals, individuals and carers
- Strong IT and record-keeping skills

Essential Requirements
- Access to a vehicle and willingness to travel as required
- Ability to attend the office regularly
- Availability to start as soon as possible
- Ability to complete all required compliance and pre-employment checks promptly

Working Arrangements

While there may be opportunities for hybrid working, successful candidates should expect to work predominantly from the Civic Centre, Wolverhampton, during the first four weeks of employment.

This induction period is designed to support:
- Team integration
- Learning and development
- Management support and supervision
- Building knowledge and confidence within the role

Following induction, working arrangements will be considered in line with service needs and manager discretion.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive pay rate of 15.56 per hour
- Opportunity to make a meaningful impact within Adult Social Care
- Valuable experience working within a forward-thinking local authority
- Supportive team environment with opportunities for learning and development
- Potential for contract extension, subject to service requirements and funding

This is an exciting opportunity to join a service committed to helping people live independently, remain connected to their communities and achieve the outcomes that matter most to them

If you do not hear back in 5 working days your application has not been successful.

title: HR Recruitment Support Executive
description:
HR Recruitment Support Executive
City of Wolverhampton Council

Civic Centre, Wolverhampton 18.85 per hour PAYE Hybrid Working 3-Month Contract

Are you an experienced recruitment professional with a strong eye for detail and a passion for delivering a high-quality recruitment service? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where compliance, stakeholder engagement and process excellence are key?

City of Wolverhampton Council is looking for an HR Recruitment Support Executive to join its busy HR and Recruitment team, supporting the delivery of end-to-end recruitment activities across the organisation.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with at least two years of recruitment experience, ideally gained within a regulated environment, who is confident managing recruitment administration, compliance processes and stakeholder queries.

The Role

As an HR Recruitment Support Executive, you will play a vital role in ensuring recruitment processes run smoothly and efficiently. Working closely with hiring managers and HR colleagues, you will support a variety of recruitment and compliance activities while helping to maintain excellent candidate and manager experiences.

This position would suit an organised and proactive recruitment professional who enjoys problem-solving, managing competing priorities and supporting recruitment projects.

Key Responsibilities
- Reviewing and approving vacancy requisitions, ensuring accuracy of position numbers, advert details and DBS requirements.
- Supporting the recruitment of senior-level appointments across the organisation.
- Managing and resolving recruitment and compliance queries from hiring managers.
- Chasing outstanding DBS documentation and supporting the completion of pre-employment checks.
- Handling DBS-related enquiries and ensuring compliance with recruitment procedures.
- Producing recruitment reports and supporting the analysis of performance metrics and recruitment data.
- Assisting with recruitment improvement initiatives and wider HR project work.
- Maintaining accurate recruitment records and supporting a compliant recruitment process.

About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:
- A minimum of two years' recruitment experience.
- Previous experience working within an HR, recruitment or talent acquisition function.
- Strong administrative and organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Experience working within a regulated environment where compliance is a key focus.
- Knowledge of DBS processes and safer recruitment practices would be highly advantageous.
- Excellent communication skills and the ability to build positive relationships with stakeholders at all levels.
- Experience producing reports and analysing recruitment performance data.
- The ability to manage multiple priorities whilst maintaining high standards of accuracy.

Why Apply?

This is a fantastic opportunity to gain experience within a large and respected local authority, supporting meaningful recruitment activity that helps deliver vital public services across the city. You will join a welcoming team environment where your recruitment expertise, attention to detail and compliance knowledge will make an immediate impact.

If you have recruitment experience, enjoy working collaboratively and have a strong understanding of compliance-focused recruitment processes, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today.

If you do not hear back in 5 working days your application has not been successful.
